title: Download the textures and sky
author: claude
summary: A script downloads the free textures and the sky picture.
what: A script (`fetch_assets.py`) downloads the free Poly Haven textures and the sky picture.
why: Free, properly licensed pictures save us from making every surface by hand.
how: One script fetches everything into a work folder that is not saved in git.

tech.name: Poly Haven
tech.plain: A free library of textures and sky pictures that anyone may use.

tech.name: Python scripts
tech.plain: Small programs that tell Blender what to build and bake, so every step can be repeated.
